results.evidence: The pitch table ends at the 2-bolt station on the ridge crest (85 m); the overview and beta add a short, very exposed Class 3 ridge-crest scramble to the true summit (reported at roughly 25 m), so a 107 m route length exceeding the pitch sum is expected. The rappel table matching the pitch sum is incidental.

Real contradiction: waypoints, trailhead card, road, approach and descent use Whiskey Bend/Elwha Snowfinger while the itinerary and timing run a Sol Duc/High Divide/Catwalk trip. Encyclopedic sources place Dana (6,213 ft) in the Bailey Range draining to the Elwha, with parent Mount Norton ~3.9 mi away; a Dodger Point page lists Dana among peaks seen from Dodger Point, which suggests the Dodger Point/Ludden ridge side, not Dodwell-Rixon Pass ~5 mi west. No source describes an actual approach or route to Dana, so neither line can be adopted and the 6-day itinerary cannot be rewritten. Settled by two trip reports of an ascent of Mount Dana naming the trailhead and approach.
